points.title: 童年与启蒙
points.description: 钱钟书1910年出生于江苏无锡一个书香门第，父亲钱基博是著名学者。自幼接受传统教育，展现出非凡的文学天赋。1920年进入无锡第一小学，1923年转入苏州桃坞中学，1925年转入美国圣公会办的苏州桃坞中学，1927年考入清华大学预科。这一时期，他广泛阅读中外文学典籍，奠定了深厚的学术基础，并开始创作诗歌和散文。无锡的童年经历对他的文学创作产生了深远影响，尤其是对江南文化的理解和感悟。
points.descriptionEn: Born in 1910 in Wuxi, Jiangsu, to a scholarly family, Qian Zhongshu showed exceptional literary talent from a young age. His father, Qian Jibo, was a renowned scholar. He received traditional education and entered Wuxi No. 1 Primary School in 1920, then transferred to Taowu Middle School in Suzhou in 1923. In 1925, he entered the American-run Taowu Middle School in Suzhou, and in 1927, he was admitted to Tsinghua University's preparatory program. During this period, he extensively read Chinese and foreign literary classics, laying a solid academic foundation and began writing poetry and essays. His childhood experiences in Wuxi profoundly influenced his literary creation, particularly his understanding and perception of Jiangnan culture.

points.title: 清华求学
points.description: 1929年，钱钟书以优异成绩考入清华大学外文系，师从吴宓、叶公超等著名学者。在清华期间，他博览群书，精通多国语言，展现出惊人的记忆力与学术才能。1933年毕业后，他继续在清华研究院深造，1935年以优异成绩毕业。这一时期，他创作了大量诗歌、散文和短篇小说，并开始构思长篇小说《围城》。清华的学术氛围和自由思想塑造了他的学术品格，也为他后来的学术研究和文学创作奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1929, Qian Zhongshu was admitted to the Department of Foreign Languages at Tsinghua University with excellent results, studying under renowned scholars such as Wu Mi and Ye Gongchao. During his time at Tsinghua, he extensively read various books, mastered multiple languages, and demonstrated remarkable memory and academic talent. After graduating in 1933, he continued his studies at Tsinghua Research Institute and graduated with excellent results in 1935. During this period, he wrote numerous poems, essays, and short stories, and began conceiving his novel 'Fortress Besieged'. The academic atmosphere and free thought at Tsinghua shaped his academic character and laid a solid foundation for his later academic research and literary creation.

points.title: 留学英国
points.description: 1935年，钱钟书获得庚子赔款奖学金，与妻子杨绛一同前往英国牛津大学埃克塞特学院留学。他主修英国文学，同时广泛研究欧洲大陆文学和哲学。在牛津期间，他完成了学术论文《十七世纪英国文学中的中国》，并开始构思《管锥编》的写作框架。这段海外经历极大地拓展了他的国际视野，使他能够以比较文学的视角审视中西文化，为后来的学术研究提供了独特的跨文化视角。1937年，他以优异成绩获得牛津大学学士学位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1935, Qian Zhongshu received a Boxer Indemnity Scholarship and went to study at Exeter College, Oxford University, with his wife Yang Jiang. He majored in English literature while extensively studying European continental literature and philosophy. During his time at Oxford, he completed his academic thesis 'China in Seventeenth-Century English Literature' and began conceiving the framework for his later work 'Guan Zhui Bian'. This overseas experience greatly expanded his international perspective, enabling him to examine Chinese and Western cultures from a comparative literature perspective, providing a unique cross-cultural viewpoint for his later academic research. In 1937, he graduated with excellent results and received a bachelor's degree from Oxford University.

points.title: 学术与创作高峰
points.description: 1938年，钱钟书回国后先后在西南联合大学、清华大学任教。1941年，日军占领上海后，他困居上海，在极其艰难的条件下坚持学术研究和文学创作。这一时期，他完成了代表作《围城》(1947年出版)，被誉为中国现代文学的经典之作。同时，他开始撰写学术巨著《谈艺录》的初稿。上海沦陷时期的生活经历，使他对人性和社会有了更深刻的认识，这些思考都反映在他的文学创作中。《围城》的出版奠定了他在中国现代文学史上的重要地位。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to China in 1938, Qian Zhongshu successively taught at Southwest Associated University and Tsinghua University. After the Japanese occupation of Shanghai in 1941, he was trapped in Shanghai and persisted in academic research and literary creation under extremely difficult conditions. During this period, he completed his masterpiece 'Fortress Besieged' (published in 1947), which is hailed as a classic of modern Chinese literature. At the same time, he began writing the first draft of his monumental academic work 'Tan Yi Lu'. His life experience during the Shanghai occupation period gave him a deeper understanding of human nature and society, which reflected in his literary creation. The publication of 'Fortress Besieged' established his important position in the history of modern Chinese literature.

points.title: 晚年学术成就
points.description: 1949年后，钱钟书先后担任清华大学教授、中国社会科学院研究员等职。1950年代至1970年代，在政治运动频繁的环境下，他仍坚持学术研究，完成了《宋诗选注》(1958)、《管锥编》(1979)等重要学术著作。《管锥编》是一部融贯中西的学术巨著，被誉为20世纪中国学术的里程碑。1980年代后，他的学术成就得到国际认可，多次受邀赴国外讲学。晚年，他几乎谢绝一切社交活动，专注于学术研究和整理旧作。1998年12月19日，钱钟书在北京逝世，享年88岁。他的逝世标志着一个时代的结束，但他的学术遗产至今仍影响着中国学术界。
points.descriptionEn: After 1949, Qian Zhongshu successively served as a professor at Tsinghua University and a researcher at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences. From the 1950s to the 1970s, despite frequent political movements, he persisted in academic research and completed important academic works such as 'Selected Notes on Song Poetry' (1958) and 'Guan Zhui Bian' (1979). 'Guan Zhui Bian' is a monumental academic work that integrates Chinese and Western scholarship, hailed as a milestone in 20th-century Chinese academia. In the 1980s, his academic achievements gained international recognition, and he was frequently invited to give lectures abroad. In his later years, he almost refused all social activities and focused on academic research and organizing his old works. On December 19, 1998, Qian Zhongshu passed away in Beijing at the age of 88. His death marked the end of an era, but his academic legacy continues to influence Chinese academia today.

supporter.zh: 钱钟书是中国现代学术与文学的双料大师，他的《围城》被誉为中国现代文学的经典之作，《管锥编》则是融贯中西的学术巨著。他精通多国语言，学贯中西，以独特的比较文学视角审视中西文化，为中国学术走向世界做出了重要贡献。他的学术成就不仅体现在文学研究上，更在于开创了中国比较文学研究的新范式。钱钟书以其渊博的学识、严谨的治学态度和独特的学术风格，成为中国现代知识分子的典范。
supporter.en: Qian Zhongshu was a dual master of modern Chinese academia and literature. His 'Fortress Besieged' is hailed as a classic of modern Chinese literature, while 'Guan Zhui Bian' is a monumental work integrating Chinese and Western scholarship. Fluent in multiple languages and well-versed in both Chinese and Western cultures, he examined Chinese and Western civilizations from a unique comparative literature perspective, making significant contributions to Chinese academia's global engagement. His achievements not only lie in literary research but also in pioneering a new paradigm for comparative literature studies in China. With his profound knowledge, rigorous scholarship, and unique academic style, Qian Zhongshu became a model of modern Chinese intellectuals.

critic.zh: 钱钟书的学术成就虽高，但也存在一些争议。有批评者认为他的某些著作过于晦涩难懂，脱离大众读者；《围城》中对知识分子的讽刺也被一些人认为过于刻薄。此外，在政治动荡的年代，他选择相对沉默，未能像同时代一些知识分子那样积极参与社会变革。还有人指出，他的学术研究虽然广博，但在某些领域的深度可能有所不足。这些批评反映了钱钟书作为知识分子在特定历史环境下的局限性和复杂性。
critic.en: Despite his high academic achievements, Qian Zhongshu also faced criticism. Some critics argue that certain of his works are overly obscure and inaccessible to general readers; his satire on intellectuals in 'Fortress Besieged' was also considered by some as overly harsh. Additionally, during politically turbulent times, he chose relative silence and did not actively participate in social transformation like some of his contemporaries. Others point out that while his academic research is broad, its depth in certain areas may be insufficient. These criticisms reflect the limitations and complexity of Qian Zhongshu as an intellectual in specific historical contexts.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，钱钟书被定位为20世纪中国最具国际影响力的学者之一。他的学术成就和文学创作跨越了中西文化边界，成为中国现代文化走向世界的重要象征。《围城》中的'围城'意象已成为中国文化中的经典隐喻，被广泛引用和讨论。钱钟书以其博学多才和独特的人格魅力，成为中国文化界的一个传奇人物。他的生平和作品不仅被学术界深入研究，也成为大众文化中知识分子形象的典型代表，体现了中国传统与现代、东方与西方文化交融的独特魅力。
objective.en: In historical academia and popular culture, Qian Zhongshu is positioned as one of the most influential Chinese scholars of the 20th century with international impact. His academic achievements and literary creations transcend Chinese and Western cultural boundaries, becoming an important symbol of modern Chinese culture's global engagement. The 'fortress besieged' imagery from his novel has become a classic metaphor in Chinese culture, widely cited and discussed. With his erudition and unique personal charm, Qian Zhongshu has become a legendary figure in Chinese cultural circles. His life and works are not only deeply studied in academic circles but also represent a typical image of intellectuals in popular culture, reflecting the unique charm of the integration of traditional and modern, Eastern and Western cultures.

self.zh: 围在城里的人想逃出来，城外的人想冲进去，对婚姻也罢，职业也罢，人生的愿望大都如此。
self.en: People in the fortress want to escape, while people outside want to get in. It's the same with marriage, career, and most of life's desires.

others.zh: 钱钟书的学问，如大海之渊，如高山之峻，如星空之远，如日月之明，如珠玉之润，如金石之声。
others.en: Qian Zhongshu's scholarship is as deep as the ocean, as lofty as mountains, as vast as the starry sky, as bright as the sun and moon, as smooth as pearls and jade, and as resonant as metal and stone.
